description: Enables synced block support in TmNotionEditor — a block whose content is shared across multiple pages. Edits in any instance propagate to all other references. Synced blocks are hidden from the slash menu when this provider is not supplied.

methods.name: GetSyncedChildBlocksAsync
methods.description: Returns the current child blocks of the synced block (its shared content).

parameters.name: syncId
parameters.description: Unique sync group ID shared by all references.

methods.name: UpdateSyncedChildBlocksAsync
methods.description: Persists content changes to the synced block. All references automatically reflect the change.

methods.name: GetAllSyncRefsAsync
methods.description: Returns all pages and block IDs that reference the given sync group. Used to show the 'N synced copies' indicator.

methods.name: CreateSyncRefAsync
methods.description: Creates a new synced block reference on the target page that mirrors the given sync group.

methods.name: UnsyncBlockAsync
methods.description: Detaches a synced block reference, converting it to a regular standalone block with a copy of the current content.
